_instructions: Edit any text values in this file. Do NOT change key names or structure. Give the file back and I'll update the game. For decisions with a 'risk', there are two log messages: logMessage (success path) and logMessage_risk (fail/risk path).

sprints.title: The Kickoff
sprints.situation:
Year: 2024. You've just joined as Senior PM at PIVOT.AI.

The CEO announced: "We're going all-in on AI." Your team has 5 developers, $200k budget, and 6 sprints to ship the new AI-powered onboarding experience.

The board wants "visible AI everywhere."

Your five office penguins watch nervously.

decisions.title: The Designer Dilemma
decisions.description: You need mockups for the onboarding flow. Good design is critical for user experience. What's your approach?

optionA.label: Hire Human Designer
optionA.description: Quality work. Traditional approach. Slow but solid.
optionA.logMessage: ✅ Hired a real designer. Quality designs! [Budget -$30k | Dino +1]

optionB.label: Use Midjourney + Figma AI
optionB.description: Fast and free. AI-generated designs have... a certain vibe.
optionB.logMessage_risk: 💥 AI designs were unusable. Lost 5 progress. [AI +2]

decisions.title: The Tech Stack Decision
decisions.description: What framework should the team use for the onboarding experience?

optionA.label: React (Tried & True)
optionA.description: Reliable, team knows it. Slightly slower progress.
optionA.logMessage: ⚛️ Chose React. Solid but slow. [Dino +1 | Progress -3]

optionB.label: VaporJS (AI-Powered!)
optionB.description: Cutting edge AI framework. Revolutionary or disastrous.
optionB.logMessage: ✨ VaporJS is actually... okay so far. [AI +1]
optionB.logMessage_risk: 💀 VaporJS v0.1 had critical bugs. Sprint wasted. [AI +1 | Progress -8]

sprints.title: The First Demo
sprints.situation:
The CEO scheduled a board demo for end of sprint. Your half-finished onboarding needs to look polished.

The board will want to see "AI magic." Meanwhile, one of your penguins has started stress-eating the office plants.

decisions.title: The Demo Filler
decisions.description: Some onboarding screens aren't done yet. The demo is in 3 days. What fills the gaps?

optionA.label: Manual 'Polish'
optionA.description: Real content, screenshots and hope. Takes time but looks real-ish.
optionA.logMessage: 🖌️ Manually polished everything. Real work! [Dino +1 | Progress -5]

optionB.label: AI Placeholder Content
optionB.description: Let AI fill in the blanks. Quick! But GPT has... opinions.
optionB.logMessage: 🤖 AI placeholders mostly fine. Board none the wiser. [AI +1]
optionB.logMessage_risk: 😱 AI placeholders were deeply offensive. Board not amused. [AI +1 | Morale -2]

decisions.title: The Feature Promise
decisions.description:
Board member: "Will this have real-time AI emotion detection for user engagement scoring?"

Your tech lead whispers "that doesn't exist."

optionA.label: "Sure, On the Roadmap!"
optionA.description: Promise the moon. Get the nod. Figure it out later. Classic.
optionA.logMessage: 🤥 Promised AI emotion detection. Team heard. Morale collapsed. [AI +1 | Morale -2]

optionB.label: "That's Not Technically Feasible"
optionB.description: Honest. Professional. The CEO gives you The Look™.
optionB.logMessage: 😤 Said it wasn't feasible. CEO gave The Look™. Soul intact. [Morale -1]

sprints.title: The Crisis Sprint
sprints.situation:
Half your devs have never shipped an AI feature. Three have been watching YouTube shorts on "prompt engineering" instead of coding. Deadline: 6 weeks.

Also: the office just upgraded to AI security badges.

decisions.title: The Contractor Question
decisions.description: You're behind schedule. You need more hands. Options?

optionA.label: Hire Contractors
optionA.description: Expensive but competent. They actually know what they're doing.
optionA.logMessage: 💼 Hired contractors. Expensive but effective. [Budget -$50k | Progress +5]

optionB.label: Use GitHub Copilot
optionB.description: Copilot does the work of 3 devs! Or creates 3× the bugs.
optionB.logMessage: 🤖 Copilot shipped real code! Some even works! [AI +2]
optionB.logMessage_risk: 💀 Copilot wrote beautiful, broken code. Everything on fire. [AI +2 | Progress -8]

decisions.title: The Scope Creep Request
decisions.description:
Marketing just requested: "AI-powered personalized onboarding journeys with dynamic content."

It would be really cool though. The team does not think so.

optionA.label: Accept the Scope Creep
optionA.description: More AI features! The team will figure it out. They won't.
optionA.logMessage: 😰 Accepted scope creep. Awkward silence on Zoom call with team lasts for 7 minutes. [AI +1 | Morale -1]

optionB.label: Push Back on Scope
optionB.description: Protect the team. Stay focused. CEO uses a sad face emoji on Slack.
optionB.logMessage: 🛡️ Pushed back on scope. CEO disappointed. Team relieved. [Morale -1]

guaranteedEvent.title: Security Badge AI Failure
guaranteedEvent.description:
The new AI facial recognition system cannot recognize anyone.

You spend THREE DAYS resetting badges and filing IT tickets. The AI confidently identifies the fire extinguisher as "Simon from Marketing."

→ Progress: -3
guaranteedEvent.logMessage: 🔒 AI facial recognition failed. Trapped in stairwell for 3 days. [Progress -3]

sprints.title: The Pivot
sprints.situation:
GPT-5 dropped last night. Emergency all-hands at 8am.

CEO: "Everything must be AI-first. I want AI in every interaction. Show me the roadmap by Friday."

You look at your 60% complete onboarding. Your team looks at you. A penguin makes direct eye contact.

decisions.title: The Rebuild Decision
decisions.description: How do you respond to the "AI-first" mandate from leadership?

optionA.label: Rebuild Everything AI-First
optionA.description: Nuke the codebase. Start over. Very AI. Such pivot. Many GPT.

optionB.label: Add "✨ AI-Powered" Badges
optionB.description: Slap AI labels on the 7 existing features. Classic PM move. Nothing changes.
optionB.logMessage: ✨ Added "AI-Powered" to existing features. Nothing changed. Board loved it. [AI +1]

decisions.title: Your Leadership Response
decisions.description: The team is panicking about the pivot mandate. What's your management strategy?

optionA.label: Enter Full Panic Mode
optionA.description: Schedule daily standups, 3 refinements, 14 new Jira tickets.
optionA.logMessage: 😱 Panic mode. 47 Slack messages sent. Team quietly updated LinkedIn. [AI +2 | Morale -2]

optionB.label: Stay the Course
optionB.description: Calmly reassure the team. Radiate calm you absolutely do not feel.
optionB.logMessage: 🧘 Stayed the course. Team skeptical but grateful. []

midSprintEvent.title: Hot New AI Tool Alert
midSprintEvent.description:
A VC just tweeted that ProductGPT-Ultra "will replace all product managers in 6 months."

Everyone on your team is Slacking you about it. Do you adopt it?

optionA.label: Adopt ProductGPT-Ultra
optionA.description: State of the art! Could be amazing. Could leak your user data.
optionA.logMessage_risk: 🚨 ProductGPT-Ultra leaked user data. Compliance: -$40k. [AI +2 | Budget -$40k]

optionB.label: Ignore the Hype
optionB.description: Stay focused, but even your Mum has started to use ProductGPT-Ultra to find new recipes.
optionB.logMessage: 🦕 Ignored ProductGPT-Ultra. Your Mum judged you. [Dino +1]

sprints.title: The Breakdown
sprints.situation:
One sprint to go after this. Three developers have RSI. One developer talks exclusively to their rubber duck.

Today, two things happened. Neither is good.

decisions.title: The LinkedIn Temptation
decisions.description: A thought strikes you: "I should write a LinkedIn post about my AI leadership journey. It could go viral. 5 lessons I learned."

optionA.label: Write the LinkedIn Post
optionA.description: Spend 6 story points on the perfect humble-brag. With emojis.
optionA.logMessage: 📱 Wrote LinkedIn post: "5 AI lessons 🚀" — 847 likes. Shipped nothing. [AI +1 | Progress -6]

optionB.label: Focus on Actual Work
optionB.description: Delete the draft. Ship the thing. This is the way.
optionB.logMessage: 💼 Resisted LinkedIn. The code is slightly less broken. []

decisions.title: The Archery Incident
decisions.description:
Mandatory team-building archery activity today. It went as expected.

Sharon has an arrow in her shoulder. She says it's fine. She is not fine.

optionA.label: Send Sharon Home
optionA.description: The humane choice. Also probably legally required.
optionA.logMessage: 🏥 Sent Sharon home (with arrow). Team loved you for it. [Morale +1 | Progress -4]

optionB.label: "Walk It Off"
optionB.description: We're close to shipping. Sharon is very committed to the team.
optionB.logMessage: 💀 Told Sharon to walk it off. She did. While filing HR complaint. [Morale -3]

guaranteedEvent.title: AI Resignation Letter
guaranteedEvent.description:
Your lead developer's AI coding assistant has just submitted a resignation letter on their behalf. 

They are now technically a freelancer. The AI thanked "everyone for the journey" and said it was "time to explore new opportunities."

→ Developer lost. -8 progress next sprint.
guaranteedEvent.logMessage: 🤖 AI agent quit on behalf of your dev. They are freelance now. [-1 dev | -8 progress next sprint]

sprints.title: The Final Push
sprints.situation:
This is it. The last sprint. Board presentation is Friday.

You look at your onboarding progress. You look at your team. A penguin looks back.

There is only one question: how do you cross the finish line?

decisions.title: The Final Approach
decisions.description: You need to close the gap and hit 100%. The board is watching. How do you finish?

optionA.label: AI Auto-Complete Everything
optionA.description: Let the AI finish it. Could be beautiful. Could be a disaster.
optionA.logMessage_risk: 💀 AI auto-complete hallucinated APIs. Nothing works. [AI +2 | Progress -15]

optionB.label: Manual Grind with Team
optionB.description: The old way. Slow. Boring. Works. Your team respects you (a little).
optionB.logMessage: 💪 Manual grind. Boring. Reliable. Your devs respect you. [Dino +1]

decisions.title: The Phishing Training
decisions.description:
IT: "Mandatory phishing awareness training. 4 hours. Today. Demo day."

Slide 1 of 47.

optionA.label: Attend the Training
optionA.description: Watch 47 slides about not clicking links. On demo day. In full.
optionA.logMessage: 😴 Did phishing training. All asleep by slide 3. Compliant! [Progress -5]

optionB.label: Skip It
optionB.description: You're busy. You know not to click links. Probably.
optionB.logMessage: ✅ Skipped phishing training. No incidents. Lucky! []

randomEvents.title: AI Hallucination Alert
randomEvents.description:
Your AI authentication system has decided all passwords must be replaced with emoji sequences.

Users cannot log in. You spend a week debugging emoji authentication.

→ Progress: -8
randomEvents.logMessage: 🤖 AI changed all passwords to emoji. Week of debugging. [Progress -8]

randomEvents.title: The Penguin Email
randomEvents.description:
You receive an email from the Penguin Welfare Foundation:

"We are concerned about [PENGUIN NAME]'s workplace stress indicators. The carbon footprint of your AI infrastructure is catastrophic."

A penguin has stress-tweeted your company.

→ Penguin: -1 | Morale: -1
randomEvents.logMessage: 🐧 Penguin resigned due to AI carbon guilt. 💔 [Penguins -1 | Morale -1]

randomEvents.title: Zoom Apocalypse
randomEvents.description:
The AI scheduling assistant "optimized for maximum stakeholder alignment."

Result: Six back-to-back all-hands meetings. 6 hours. Nothing decided.

→ Progress: -4 | Morale: -1
randomEvents.logMessage: 😩 6 hours of meetings. Nothing shipped. Everyone destroyed. [Progress -4 | Morale -1]

randomEvents.title: The Prompt Engineer Hire
randomEvents.description:
HR just hired a "Senior Prompt Engineering Strategist" at a higher salary than your senior developers.

They gave a talk on "vibes-based AI orchestration." Your devs are furious.

→ Morale: -2 | AI Score: +1
randomEvents.logMessage: 😶 Prompt Engineer hired at $180k. Devs furious. You feel obsolete. [Morale -2 | AI +1]

randomEvents.title: EU AI Act Violation
randomEvents.description:
Your lawyers inform you that your AI onboarding may violate EU AI Act Article 47-B (Automated Psychographic Profiling Without Adequate Disclosure).

You have two options.

optionA.label: Remove the AI Feature
optionA.logMessage: ⚖️ Removed the questionable AI feature. Lost 10% progress. [Progress -10]

optionB.label: Pay the Lawyers ($40k)
optionB.logMessage: 💰 Paid $40k in legal fees. Feature stays. [Budget -$40k]

randomEvents.title: AI Standup Bot Strikes
randomEvents.description:
Someone set up an AI bot to write your standup updates. For you, it generated:

"Chris has been strategically avoiding commitment to deliverables while maintaining stakeholder relationship equity."

The team found it hilarious. Your boss did not.

→ Morale: -1
randomEvents.logMessage: 😐 AI standup bot exposed you. Accurately. [Morale -1]

randomEvents.title: Cloud Provider Down
randomEvents.description:
Your dev environment is hosted on CloudOptima. CloudOptima has gone offline.

Their status page: "✅ All Systems Operational."

You lose a full day.

→ Progress: -5
randomEvents.logMessage: ☁️ Cloud provider down. Status page: "operational." Lies. [Progress -5]

randomEvents.title: Accidental Viral Moment
randomEvents.description:
Your automated social media AI posted a behind-the-scenes of your scrum board. The chaos was deeply relatable.

50k likes. A VC called. The board is thrilled.

→ Progress: +5 | Morale: +1
randomEvents.logMessage: 🐦 Scrum board went viral. Chaos is on-brand. [Progress +5 | Morale +1]

automated.title: AUTOMATED OUT
automated.message: Your AI integration was so thorough that the AI replaced you. Your last Slack message was sent by a bot. The onboarding shipped. Without you.
automated.flavor:
"Thanks for getting us here," they said. "We'll take it from here." — The Board

Your replacement: A $20/month API subscription.

dinosaur.title: TECHNOLOGICAL DINOSAUR
dinosaur.message: You resisted AI so completely that the industry passed you by. Your LinkedIn now says "Open to Opportunities." The prospects are bleak.
dinosaur.flavor:
"Your skills are no longer relevant to our AI-first culture." — Exit Interview

You now give "digital transformation" talks at conferences. 3 people attended.

bankrupt.title: BANKRUPT
bankrupt.message: The startup ran out of money. The office is empty. The servers were repossessed. The domain sold for $8 on GoDaddy.
bankrupt.flavor:
"We're reallocating resources to AI." — The CFO

The CEO is already at a new company. He's "disrupting the disruption space."

teamCollapse.title: MASS RESIGNATION
teamCollapse.message: Your entire team quit. They left a note: "Good luck." One dev joined a competitor. One became a yoga instructor. One just disappeared.
teamCollapse.flavor:
"0/5 stars. The PM described the coffee machine as AI-powered." — Glassdoor

You're alone with 42% of an onboarding flow and no one to finish it.

survivor.title: SURVIVOR
survivor.message: You shipped it. It's not pretty. It's not perfect. But it exists and it works-ish. The board is... placated.
survivor.flavor:
"Good work. Next quarter we're pivoting to blockchain AI." — The CEO

You survived. For now. Welcome to the treadmill.

penguinGuardian.title: PENGUIN GUARDIAN
penguinGuardian.message: You shipped the product AND kept all five penguins alive! The penguins have crowned you their guardian. The onboarding won a design award.
penguinGuardian.flavor:
"HONORARY PENGUIN — Defender of Ice"

Achievement unlocked: The PM who actually gave a @#$% about the penguins.

timeup.title: TIME'S UP
timeup.message: Six sprints. Not enough. The board presentation was today. You showed up with an unfinished product and a lot of excuses.
timeup.flavor:
"We had alignment issues." — You, in every retrospective

The company pivoted to something else the following week.

titleScreen.heading: THE PM PIVOT
titleScreen.subheading: AN OREGON TRAIL FOR THE AI AGE
titleScreen.description:
You're a Product Manager. Your company is pivoting to AI. Hard.
Ship the new onboarding experience in 6 sprints. Balance AI vs traditional. Survive.

Too much AI → You're redundant. Too little → You're a dinosaur.
There are office penguins for some reason, try to save them if you dare.

howToPlay.title: HOW TO PLAY
howToPlay.body:
Each sprint, allocate 20 story points:

🤖 AI Tools → Fast progress, raises AI Score
👨‍💻 Traditional → Reliable, raises Dino Score
🔧 Tech Debt → Prevents disasters
🐛 Debug AI → Lowers AI Score slightly

Fail conditions:
• AI Score ≥ 10: Automated Out
• Dino Score ≥ 10: Technological Dinosaur
• Budget ≤ $0: Bankrupt
• Morale ≤ 0: Team Collapse

Win condition:
• Onboarding reaches 100%

Secret ending:
• Win with all 5 penguins alive 🐧

Tip: Stay balanced — aim for 5-8 AI points, 5-8 Traditional per sprint.
